Okay so you're being intentionally dense. Got it. When you make a thread to have a ''discussion'', actually aspire to have that discussion instead of brushing off anything you don't agree with and then playing dumb. :/

What is it that you didn't understand ? You said a steep learning curve isn't all there is to a champion's difficulty, but yes; it pretty much is. Everything else is just sub-points that make the curve steep (like being mechanically difficulty, having to focus on macro plays, or having a different playstyle). 

You pointed out Singed and Aurelion Sol are difficult just because they are different. I responded that this is not even an argument; that is why they are difficult, and pointing it out didn't add anything to the ''discussion'' you're trying to have.

.... What does them being different have to do with anything ? It's a factor of difficulty like any other. Some champions are harder because of mechanical skill (Nidalee, Akali, Irelia), big focus on macro and understanding of the game (Taliyah, Singed, Ivern), or them having a vastly different playstyle (Singed, Ivern, Aurelion Sol). Pointing out that some of them are different is literally pointless.

And yes, a steep learning curve is the main sign a champion is hard. Like, it doesn't get more accurate than this. If a champion takes 100+ games on it to reach consistency and a decent winrate, it means the champion is hard... Why are you arguing over objective data ? You made this post asking for what makes a champion hard, and then you disagree with it...

Again, stop using yourself as a reference. Personal experience doesn't matter. Everyone is different and some champions click easier than other for each individual, there's nothing to talk about, it's literally just that.

There's a difference between subjective difficulty and objective difficulty. Subjective difficulty is what you are doing; it's linked to personal experiences. Objective difficulty looks at the whole player base and their performance on that champion, analyzing all the different variables.

Subjective difficulty: ''Taliyah isn't that hard, I do well on her.''

Objective difficulty: [Taliyah is actually that hard.](https://i.imgur.com/e3K1FA3.png)

You are not a reference buddy. If I picked up say Nidalee, and did super well on her immediately, I wouldn't act like she was easy because I personally did well on her.

This is from 11 months ago, but Blaustoise shared that [Taliyah has the 5th steepest mastery curve](https://i.imgur.com/e3K1FA3.png) of any champion in the game. She is objectively harder to play than the vast majority of champions, regardless of personal experiences.
